name: FLY AND FIELD OUTFITTERS
address: 35 SW CENTURY DR STE 100, BEND, OR 97702

fr.elements: Main Residence; Vehicle Parking Area; Front Entry Area; Walkway; Landscaped Area; Dense Vegetation; Access Drive; Street Frontage
fr.considerations: Multiple Access Points; Limited Turnaround Space; Dense Vegetation; Fenced Sections
fr.recommendations:
• Mark the driveway entrance with reflective address numbers visible from both directions on the street.
• Keep the access drive clear of parked vehicles to allow fire apparatus and emergency vehicles to reach the residence.
• Trim dense vegetation along the access drive so it does not narrow the travel width or obstruct vehicle mirrors and doors.
• Cut back dense vegetation near the front entry area so responders can locate and reach the main door without obstruction.
• Identify a flat, open area near the residence where emergency vehicles can turn around and mark it clearly for responder awareness.
• Keep all fenced sections with gates unlocked or secured with a single standard padlock to allow responders to move between sections without delay.
• Trim vegetation away from fence gates so gates can be fully opened during an emergency.
• Clear a path along the walkway wide enough for two responders carrying equipment to move side by side.

wildfire.conditions: Scattered Trees; Tree Cluster; Scattered Shrubs; Vegetation Near Structure; Open Terrain; Adequate Vegetation Separation; Multiple Access Routes; Irrigated Landscape
wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim branches from the scattered trees near the structure to create more open space between the tree canopy and the roof or walls.
• Thin the tree cluster to reduce the density of branches and limbs that could carry fire toward the structure.
• Remove shrubs that are growing directly against or immediately next to the structure.
• Separate shrubs from the base of the structure by clearing a several-foot gap of bare ground or low ground cover.
• Keep the irrigated landscape areas watered and mowed short, especially where they connect to the scattered shrubs or trees.
• Trim any low-hanging branches from scattered trees that extend over the roof or gutters.
• Remove dead branches and dry material from within the tree cluster closest to the structure.
• Keep both access routes clear of overhanging branches and encroaching shrubs along their full length.
• Move any stored materials, wood piles, or yard debris away from the base of the structure and out from under decks or overhangs.
